summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, arguing that it would jeopardize school and library budgets and progress in maintaining affordable internet access.

claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading networks.
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate is critical for schools and libraries to maintain affordable, reliable access to the Internet. Terminating that support represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks.
